steps.caption: Estimate & invoice defaults
steps.narration: Document defaults are what every new estimate and invoice starts with.

steps.caption: Pre-filled
steps.narration: They are pre-filled on every new document. You can still edit each one.

steps.caption: Estimate footer
steps.narration: Estimate footer is the closing line on your estimates.

steps.value: Thank you for your business. We appreciate you.
steps.caption: Invoice footer
steps.narration: Invoice footer does the same for invoices. Let's write a new one.

steps.caption: Terms & conditions
steps.narration: Terms and conditions holds your standard terms.

steps.caption: Warranty text
steps.narration: Warranty text holds your standard warranty.

steps.caption: Default deposit
steps.narration: Default deposit is the percent you ask for up front. We'll make it twenty-five.

steps.caption: Default sales tax
steps.narration: Default sales tax is a fallback. It's used when no city or division rate matches.

steps.caption: Menu: Settings
steps.narration: You'll find these defaults under Settings in the menu.

youtube.title: How to set estimate and invoice defaults | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Estimate and invoice defaults in the ConstructHUB CRM settings. You will see the footers, terms and warranty text that pre-fill every new document, change the default deposit, and save.
